rules.statement: A pnpm workspace sets a `minimumReleaseAge` release-age gate in `pnpm-workspace.yaml` (three days, 4320 minutes), so every resolution a person runs is gated the same way Dependabot's is.
rules.why: Most compromised npm releases are found and unpublished within days. Without a workspace gate, people lock the newest version, and a version locked while still younger than Dependabot's cooldown makes every Dependabot npm version update fail.
rules.check: Look for diffs to `pnpm-workspace.yaml` that remove `minimumReleaseAge`, lower it, or set it to a value that no longer matches the Dependabot npm cooldown.

rules.statement: State the Dependabot npm `cooldown` explicitly in `dependabot.yml`, never set it to 0, and never make it longer than pnpm's `minimumReleaseAge` window.
rules.why: Relying on the unstated default would reopen a gap between the two windows if GitHub changed it. A longer cooldown lets pnpm lock versions that Dependabot then rejects. Turning the cooldown off removes a supply-chain control just to hide the mismatch.
rules.check: Flag an npm ecosystem entry in `dependabot.yml` that has no `cooldown`, has `default-days: 0`, or has a cooldown longer than the workspace `minimumReleaseAge`. Also flag a change to one window that isn't matched in the other.

rules.statement: When a package version is needed before it passes the release-age window, add it to `minimumReleaseAgeExclude` with a comment saying why, and remove the entry once that version has aged past the window.
rules.why: Urgent versions should bypass the gate deliberately and only for a limited time, so the lockfile can't quietly gain versions that Dependabot's gate rejects.
rules.check: Flag a new `minimumReleaseAgeExclude` entry that has no explanatory comment, an exclusion that is broader than the specific version needed, and stale entries for versions that are already older than the window.

rules.statement: Keep `engines.node` advisory: do not set `engineStrict` (or `engine-strict`) in a pnpm workspace that Dependabot updates.
rules.why: Dependabot's updater runs a Node version of its own choosing, which may not satisfy `engines.node`. Strict engine checks would break its updates.
rules.check: Flag a diff that adds `engineStrict: true` to `pnpm-workspace.yaml` or `engine-strict=true` to `.npmrc`.
